title: Agentic Standards Map
description:
A map of who is standardising agentic commerce, where, and what each venue has committed to next: 62 entries, one per specification, draft or working group, in W3C, IETF, GS1, UN/CEFACT, AAIF, the Linux Foundation and industry protocols.

Every entry is dated and carries its sources (over 250 primary sources and over 500 links in all); the map also follows four seams where the pieces do not yet meet, with a calendar of dated public events. Each fact is read at the primary source, and an absence is reported as not found in a named corpus on a date.

Site: https://frmoretto.github.io/agentic-standards-map/
